@Test
public void testBulletMixedEnum3() {
    String src = "#Headings
" + "#Links (with optional title)
" + "#Lists (like this one)
" + "--including nested lists
" + "#Tables
" + "--caption
" + "--headers
" + "--summary
" + "#Language information
" + "#Acronyms and abbreviations
" + "#Emphasis and strong emphasis
" + "#Quotes, inline and block
" + "#Images";
    String target = "#Headings
" + "#Links (with optional title)
" + "#Lists (like this one)
" + "**including nested lists
" + "#Tables
" + "**caption
" + "**headers
" + "**summary
" + "#Language information
" + "#Acronyms and abbreviations
" + "#Emphasis and strong emphasis
" + "#Quotes, inline and block
" + "#Images";
    Assert.assertEquals(target, translate(src));
}

@Test
public void testTilde() {
    String src = "==Willkommen zum WikiWizardScript
" + "~~ sdfsdf
" + "
" + "now what happens?
" + "
" + "- nothing I hope
" + "- maybe something
" + "- we will soon see!
" + "
" + "== and this is a big title =================
" + "
" + "What can we put here?
" + "
" + "{{Web2.png}}";
    String target = "!!!Willkommen zum WikiWizardScript
" + "~~ sdfsdf
" + "
now what happens?
" + "
* nothing I hope
" + "* maybe something
" + "* we will soon see!
" + "
!!! and this is a big title ===============
" + "
What can we put here?
" + "
[{Image src='Web2.png'}]";
    Assert.assertEquals(target, translate(src));
}
